confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated crowd-sourced and listing-based price points (MyLifeElsewhere, Preciosmundi, 3Pulse, Expatistan) and hotel-menu data, which vary widely by venue type. Beer and coffee are the most reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and were set relative to beer and hotel-bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. FX: the only RBA observation I could verify is 0.7088 USD per AUD dated 2026-03-20, which is months older than the generation date; a more recent RBA F11 figure could not be confirmed, so this rate may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against typical Indian tourist-city restaurant and cafe levels (for example Delhi and Bhopal listings) and a discount for Varanasi's lower general price level, with hotel tiers based on general knowledge of Varanasi guesthouse and mid-range hotel rates.
